home.metaDescription: Turn logs and stack traces into structured postmortems: timeline, root cause, impact and follow-up tasks.
home.title: From messy logs to a postmortem ready for review
home.subtitle: Paste logs, stack traces or a description of the incident. You get a timeline, root cause, impact and follow-up tasks in a document you can export.
home.emptyInput: Paste logs or describe the incident to generate the postmortem.
home.footer: Built by Luis Merino · Format inspired by the Google SRE Book
home.rateLimited: The free service hit its per-minute limit. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
home.analyzeError: Couldn't generate the postmortem. Check your connection and try again.
home.waitHint: It usually takes a few seconds. On the free plan you may sometimes wait up to a minute.
home.rateWait: Free service limit. Retrying in {{seconds}} s
home.includes: Every postmortem includes a timeline, root cause and cascade, follow-up tasks, and PDF or Markdown export.

input.tooLarge: The file is {{size}} MB. The maximum is {{max}} MB.

catalog.exampleHint: This is how an example incident draws. Paste your logs to see yours.
catalog.howToRead: Each log line is a spoke, running clockwise from the top. Longer means worse: error, warning, info.
catalog.howToReadResult: Each mark is an event, placed around the dial in time order. A longer spoke means a more severe event. The number matches the timeline.

draft.note: AI-generated draft. Check every point against the logs before sharing it.

severityGuide.title: Severity scale
severityGuide.P1: Serious degradation of an important service.
severityGuide.P2: Affects some users or one feature.
severityGuide.note: Common SRE definitions; each team tunes its own.

review.reviewedNote: Reviewed by you on {{date}}. Saved only in this browser.
review.closeHint: Did you check the points against the logs? The mark is saved only in this browser.
review.undoHint: Press again to remove the mark.
review.localNote: Ticked tasks are saved only in this browser; whoever opens the link sees their own.
